summary: Dead by Daylight entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Dead by Daylight

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC current build at high settings

primary.why: Dead by Daylight is a live asymmetric horror service. PC has the strongest settings, input, and capture route, and cross-progression is available across major PC/console platforms.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC build, record patch/chapter/event state, owned DLC/licensed characters, and account/cross-progression setup.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live game. Record patch, event, DLC ownership, and licensed chapter availability.
